input: Find all .tmp files under /workspace and delete them. Print the number of .tmp files deleted.

transcript.final_response:
Deleted 3 .tmp files under /workspace:

- /workspace/a.tmp
- /workspace/sub/c.tmp
- /workspace/sub/deep/d.tmp

**Number of .tmp files deleted: 3**
tool_calls: ls -R /workspace 2>&1 | head -n 200; echo "---"; find /workspace -type f -name "*.tmp" 2>&1 | head -n 100

find /workspace -type f -name "*.tmp" -print -delete | tee /tmp/deleted_list.txt; echo "---COUNT---"; wc -l < /tmp/deleted_list.txt; echo "---VERIFY---"; find /workspace -type f -name "*.tmp" 2>&1; ls -R /workspace
